Search is amber's AI-powered enterprise search. It makes knowledge from distributed sources searchable and usable, helping employees quickly find what they need.
How is Search different from traditional enterprise search solutions?
Search goes beyond simple document search. It combines AI search with company knowledge to provide relevant results and usable answers.
Security and compliance are core parts of the amber platform. Existing access rights are preserved, so users can only access content they are authorized to view.
How do implementation, trial phase, and pricing work?
Search can be introduced step by step and is supported by structured onboarding. Roll-out and pricing depend on the use case, integration depth, and scope of usage.
